question.text: A point charge q is kept inside an uncharged conducting spherical shell. The radius of the shell is R and the charge is kept inside the shell at a distance x from the centre. Identify the correct statement.

options.text: Net force acting on the shell is zero
Net force on the shell is towards right side
Net force on the shell is towards left side
Nothing can be said about the net direction of the net force on the shell.

solution.text: Charge induced near the surface closer to the charged particle will be more and hence sphere will be attracted to the charge q. Hence net force is towards left.
